name: PD 352 was established by Ordinance No. 20942, passed by the Dallas City Council on May 8,
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 352 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-352.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 352 was established by Ordinance No. 20942, passed by the Dallas City Council on May 8, 1991. Ordinance No. 20942 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 20942; 25850)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-352.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 352 is established on property generally fronting on the west line of Bentwood Trail, north of the north line of Smoke Glass Trail. The size of PD 352 is approximately 14.877 acres. (Ord. Nos. 20942; 25850)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-352.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A. (Ord. 25850)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-352.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development on the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 352A). (Ord. Nos. 20942; 25850)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-352.105. USES.

The only uses permitted on the Property are those allowed in the R-7.5(A) Single Family District. (Ord. Nos. 20942; 25850)

sections.title: Density
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-352.106. DENSITY.

No more than 66 dwelling units are permitted on the Property. (Ord. Nos. 20942; 25850)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-352.107. SIGNS.

All signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Section 51A-7.402. (Ord. Nos. 20942; 25850)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-352.108. SETBACKS.

Front, side, and rear yard setbacks must be provided as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 20942; 25850)

sections.title: Lot Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-352.109. LOT SIZE.

Minimum lot size on the Property is 5,000 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 20942; 25850)

sections.title: Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-352.110. HEIGHT.

No structure on the Property may exceed 30 feet in height. (Ord. Nos. 20942; 25850)

sections.title: Lot Coverage
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-352.111. LOT COVERAGE.

Maximum lot coverage on the Property is 45 percent for residential structures and 25 percent for nonresidential structures. (Ord. Nos. 20942; 25850)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-352.112. OFF-STREET PARKING.

Off-street parking must be provided in accordance with the requirements of Chapter 51A. (Ord. Nos. 20942; 25850)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-352.113. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

(a) Use of the Property must comply with all applicable federal and state laws and regulations, and with all applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(c) The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 20942; 25850)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-352.114. ZONING MAP.

PD 352 is located on Zoning Map No. AA-7. (Ord. Nos. 20942; 25850)
